productionDecision: No code was changed. Patch 15B improved broad vendor/pages chunks, but vendor-map is oversized because map renderers and geospatial helpers are grouped too broadly.
likelyCause: mapbox-gl is explicitly grouped into vendor-map.
maplibre-gl is explicitly grouped into vendor-map.
@mapbox packages are explicitly grouped into vendor-map.
@maplibre packages are explicitly grouped into vendor-map.
supercluster is explicitly grouped into vendor-map.
geojson-related packages are explicitly grouped into vendor-map.

recommendedSplitStrategy.label: Separate Mapbox and MapLibre
recommendedSplitStrategy.action: Split mapbox-gl into vendor-mapbox and maplibre-gl into vendor-maplibre.
recommendedSplitStrategy.reason: Both renderers should not be forced into one vendor-map chunk if they serve different routes.

recommendedSplitStrategy.label: Move geospatial helpers out of renderer chunk
recommendedSplitStrategy.action: Move supercluster and geojson helpers into vendor-geo.
recommendedSplitStrategy.reason: Clustering and data utilities can be cached separately from renderer engines.

recommendedSplitStrategy.label: Keep @mapbox / @maplibre scoped packages separate
recommendedSplitStrategy.action: Split scoped helper packages into support chunks if they are still large.
recommendedSplitStrategy.reason: Scoped helper packages can inflate the renderer chunk.

recommendedSplitStrategy.label: Avoid grouping all map terms into one vendor-map
recommendedSplitStrategy.action: Do not use one broad vendor-map bucket for all geospatial packages.
recommendedSplitStrategy.reason: Patch 15B proved this creates one oversized chunk.

recommendedSplitStrategy.label: Build and compare
recommendedSplitStrategy.action: After tuning, compare large asset count and route-specific map chunks.
recommendedSplitStrategy.reason: We need measured proof that vendor-map shrinks without exploding too many new chunks.

recommendedPatch.label: Vendor Map Split Strategy Patch
recommendedPatch.goal: Patch vite.config.js to split vendor-map into vendor-mapbox, vendor-maplibre, vendor-geo, and map support chunks in one measured pass.

doNotDo.label: Do not rollback Patch 15B
doNotDo.reason: Patch 15B reduced broad vendor/pages pressure and left only one oversized chunk.

doNotDo.label: Do not raise chunkSizeWarningLimit
doNotDo.reason: That hides the warning without improving performance.

doNotDo.label: Do not edit core map internals yet
doNotDo.reason: Manual chunk tuning is lower risk and should be tried before touching SHSOperationalMapboxMap.jsx internals.
